items.cloneBody: Capture a clean minute of your voice. Generate hours of natural-sounding audio from text in any tone.
items.fidelityBody: Default voices feel real. Pro cloning captures cadence, breath, and inflection — not just timbre.
items.multilingualBody: Speak Turkish today, English tomorrow, Spanish next week — same voice, no extra setup.
items.conversionBody: Drop in any audio, hand back the same performance in your voice. Preserve emotion and timing.

page.heroSub: Try it free with 1,000 credits. Upgrade when your production picks up. Cancel any time — your audio and clones stay yours.
page.faqSub: Quick answers to the things people most ask before they sign up.

faq.a: One credit covers roughly one character of generated speech. A 300-word script consumes about 1,800 credits. Voice cloning and conversion are credit-free on paid plans.
Yes. Upgrade or downgrade any time. We prorate the difference and your unused credits roll over for the current billing period.

faq.q: What happens to my voice clones if I cancel?
faq.a: Your recordings and clones stay in your account in read-only mode. Generations don't refresh, but everything you've made remains downloadable. Re-subscribe any time to resume.
If something isn't right within the first 14 days, write to us and we'll refund the full month — no questions, no friction.
Your recordings are stored encrypted at rest. We never share, sell, or use your voice for training. Delete a clone and the model and source audio are gone for good within 24 hours.
Yes. One click in Settings. No retention dance, no email surveys — your subscription stops at the end of the current period.

whoWeAre.heading: Built by people who ship
whoWeAre.body: VoiceLab is a small operator-run studio. We obsess over voice quality, fast turnaround, and predictable pricing. No data goes anywhere it shouldn't. Your recordings and clones are yours — delete them whenever you want and they're gone for good.

finalCta.sub: 1,000 free credits the moment you verify your email. No credit card. Be generating in under two minutes.
